text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: While delivering a package near the coast, {0} had the misfortune of running into a horde of monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
配達の仕事を頼まれ海の近くを訪れていた
{0}は、
運悪く魔物の群れと遭遇してしまった。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Guooooooo!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Maaan, I'm starving... Hm? I think I heard some kind of animal crying out over there...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
腹減ったー……
あ、
こっちからなんか動物の鳴き声っぽい音がしたような……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Guooooooo!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's a monster... Whoa?! What's going on, {0}?! Training against monsters all the way out here? That's refresh--... No! I mean, you're really working hard!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ魔物か……
おお！？
どうしたんだよオマエ！　
こんなところで魔物相手に修行か？
清々する……
じゃない！　
精が出るな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: What, you were ambushed?! Sorry, my bad. I'll help you right away! MANIFEST... AND SLICE 'EM TO PIECES! SPIRESBANE BLAAAAADE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ襲われてたのか！
悪い悪い。
だったらすぐに助けてやるよ！
現出しながらぶった切れ天楼覇断剣ー！！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...Gyaoooo!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Heheh! That's about it! Glad you're safe!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へへーん！　
ざっとこんなもんだ！
無事で良かったな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Still, setting Landosol aside... I would've never expected to run into you here! Must be my lucky day!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しっかし
ランドソルならともかく、
こんなとこでオマエに会えるなんてな！
今日のアタシはラッキーだ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Same to you! But be more careful. If I hadn't been passing by, you might have been eaten by a monster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう！　
お互いにな！
でも気をつけろよ。
アタシが通りかかってなかったら、
魔物に食われてたかもしれないぞ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: As usual, you don't seem that comfortable fighting alone, you should've had someone come with you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
相変わらず一人で戦うのは得意じゃなさそうだし、
誰かと一緒に来ればよかったのに……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...Though I guess that wouldn't work when you're on the job. There are some things you have to do on your own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でもそれじゃあ仕事にならないか。
一人でできなきゃいけないこともあるよな。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I said that, but I was pretty desperate myself until recently, so I'm really not in any position to lecture you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんて言ってみたけど、
最近までアタシも
割と切羽詰まってたし、
オマエに偉そうなことは言えないな。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Remember how I told you I was looking for a monster when we met before? I got word that it'd been spotted somewhere out in these waters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシはほら、
前に会った時魔物を探してるって言っただろ？
ソイツがこっちの方の海に出たって情報を仕入れてさ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Apparently, it seems it's on the other end of this coast, so I figured I'd split it open with my Spiresbane Blade and head across!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうやら海の向こうにいるらしいから、
天楼覇断剣で海をたたき割って行くつもりだったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I'd feel bad asking someone to lend me a boat... so I think this is the only way I can set off by myself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰かに船を借りるのは気が引けるし、
一人で行く方法は
これしかないと思ってる！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Really? ...You're right! That makes sense! I might not be a nuisance here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか？　
……そうか！
そうだな！　
迷惑になるかもしれないしな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: While I'm dropping you off, I might as well go and talk to someone in the nearby village!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オマエを送り届けるついでに、
近くの村で相談してみるか！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: The path to the village is... around here...? Hm? There's someone over there. Oiiii!
text_block_list.orig_text:
村ってこの辺りか……
ん？
あそこに誰かいるな。
おーい！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Huh...? What's with you guys?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……？　
何モンだ、
あんたたち？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: We're here for a delivery! Hey, do you fish in this ocean? I have a favor to ask of you~
text_block_list.orig_text:
配達にきたんだ！
なあ、
アンタはこの海で
魚をとってるのか？
頼みたいことが──

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Who the hell'd listen to an outsider request!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──よそ者の頼みなど誰が聞くか。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, don't be so prickly. You could at least listen to what I have to say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい、
そんなにツンケンするなよ。
話くらい聞いてくれてもいいだろ。

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Get lost! You may be trying to sabotage my fishing, but it's useless!
text_block_list.orig_text:
失せろ！
漁を妨害したいんだろうが無駄だぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about? I'm just looking for some dangerous monster that might be in this side of the sea...
text_block_list.orig_text:
何の話だ？　
アタシはただ、
こっち側の海にいるかもしれない
ヤバい魔物を探してるだけだって。

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Don't play dumb! Get out of here in ten seconds! Otherwise, I'll stab this harpoon into your head!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とぼけるな！　
10数えるうちに立ち去れ！
さもないと
この銛を脳天に突き刺してやる！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: You're a dangerous guy! ...Well, I guess I have no choice. It pisses me off to be suspected of something I didn't do, so I guess I'll just knock you flat and make you listen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
物騒だなオマエ！　
……しょうがない。
覚えのないことで疑われてるのもムカつくし、
ぶっ倒してこっちの話を聞いてもらうか。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Surrender? You want me to put both of my hands behind my head? What happens if we get caught...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
降参？　
両手を頭の後ろに回してか？
それで捕まったりしたらどうする……？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...Nah. I'll surrender. I've got a feeling I should trust your judgment here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いいや。
するか、
降参。
なんかこういう時は
オマエを信じたほうがいい気がする。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, old man! Here, I surrender! Tie me up, throw me in ropes, whatever you want! Here! Come on! Hurry it up! Before I change my mind and slice you in half!
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪かったなおっちゃん！　
ほら
降参だ降参！
縄で縛るなり好きにしろよ！　
ほれ！　
おらっ！
さっさとしろ！　
さもないとぶった切るぞ！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Mmm... No, it's my bad. I can see you harbor no hostility after all of that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
むぅ……
いや、
俺が悪かった。
そこまでされればさすがに敵意がないのは分かる。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Sure, as long as you understand. As I said earlier, I just came here to look for monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう、
分かればいいんだよ。
さっきも言ったけど、
アタシはただ魔物を探しに来たんだ。

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: I see... I'm sorry about earlier. I suspected you guys might be poachers.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだったか……
さっきはすまなかった。
あんたたちが密漁者じゃないかと疑ってたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Poachers?
text_block_list.orig_text: 密漁者？

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: I'm a fisherman from these parts, but lately the catch has been unusually poor. There's nothing unusual about the sea, so I thought it was strange.
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺はこの辺りで漁師をしているんだが、
近頃やけに不漁続きだったんだ。
海に変化もないし、
おかしいとは思っていた。

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: So I started keeping watch on the beach, and one night I saw someone trying to set sail. I tried to catch them, but they escaped into the sea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで浜を見張るようにしたら、
ある日の夜、
誰かが舟を出そうとしていてな。
捕まえようとしたが海に逃げられてしまった。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I see. In that case, I guess it's understandable that we'd look like part of that group to you... That's tough, old man.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか。
そういうことなら
アタシたちがソイツらの一味に
見えるのも
まあ仕方ないか……
大変だな
おっちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: As I was saying, I'm keeping watch on the sea from this side and I can tell the monster you're looking for isn't here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうわけでこの辺りの海を見張っているから、
あんたの探している魔物はいないはずだ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I see. Thanks! ...Hmm, what should we do, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか。
ありがとな！
……さて、
どうする{0}？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Haha! When you were listening to the old man's story, you had that look on your face that said, "Looks like they're in trouble... I wonder if I can help somehow."
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははっ！　
おっちゃんの話を聞いてる時のオマエ、
『大変そうだな……
力になれないかな……』
って顔してたぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: In a situation like this, there's only one thing you'd want to do, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こういう時、
オマエならやりたいことは一つだろ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Old man, it's settled! We'll do something about those crooks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
決まりだな。
おっちゃん！
アタシたちがその悪いヤツら、
なんとかしてやるよ！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: You two will...?
text_block_list.orig_text: あんたたちが……？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Yup! Now what's the phrase for this again...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
こういうのなんて言うんだっけ……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's it! If they're bad guys who poach, I can fight them with all my might!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
それだ！　
密漁するような悪いヤツなら
思いっきり戦えるからな！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: That's very kind of you, but I can't leave it all to you guys. I'll go back to the village and rally my friends.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そいつはありがたいが、
あんたたちだけにまかせるわけにはいかない。
村に戻って
仲間にも声をかけてみるよ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: The more allies, the better! We're counting on you! So, when are those poachers going to show up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
仲間は多い方がいいか！　
頼んだぞ！
それで、
密漁するヤツらは
いつここに来るんだ？

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: They only appear at night. They deliberately take their boats out during times of poor visibility, before we go fishing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤツらは夜にしか現れない。
視界の悪い時間帯に
あえて舟を出すんだ。
俺たちが漁へ出る前にな。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: And by the time you and your folk get to your boats, all the fishes are caught and gone... What a bunch of nuisances!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっちゃんたちが漁場についた頃には、
魚はとっくに取りつくされた後なのか……
悪どいヤツらだな！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Right? I was making my rounds because I figured they'd show up again around tonight. See you here at night. We'll get everything ready by then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だろう？　
ちょうど今日くらいにまた舟を出すだろうと思って
見回っていたところだったのさ。
夜にまたここで会おう。
それまでに準備を済ませておくよ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Yeah. See you later!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
また後でなー！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Now then... let's kill time until nightfall. Heh heh... I wonder how I'm gonna beat those guys down...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて……
近くで夜まで待つか！
どうやってぶっ倒すかなー……
へへへっ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Peacefully, huh? Good grief, you really are a nice guy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
平和か……
やれやれ。
オマエってヤツはホント、
いいヤツだな。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Okay then, let's try to solve it with peace! That said, what constitutes as "peace" here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあその平和ってのをやってみるか！
といっても、
どうするのが平和なんだ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Come on! You're the one who suggested it! Think about it! Peace, peace, peace...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
言い出しっぺなんだから
オマエも考えろ！
平和
平和
平和……

text_block_list.name: ムイミ
text_block_list.text:
密漁なんてしてる相手だし、
話してどうにかなるとは思えない。
だったら叩きのめすのが……
あー
ダメだダメだ！　
平和だ平和！
text_block_list.orig_text:
密漁なんてしてる相手だし、
話してどうにかなるとは思えない。
だったら叩きのめすのが……
あー
ダメだダメだ！　
平和だ平和！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: DAAAAAAAAAH! I've got NOTHING! How about you!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だあああ～！！！　
分からん！
オマエはどうだ！？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Oh?! I-I see! So you haven't thought of anything yet either! Thank goodness... So it's not because I'm dumb!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおっ！？　
そ、
そうか！
オマエでも思いついてないんだな！　
よかった……
アタシがバカだから考えられないってわけじゃないんだな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: If the people poaching are bad guys to begin with, then even if you and I go out there, they'll probably be the ones trying to beat us up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そもそも
密漁してるのが悪いヤツなら、
アタシとオマエが出ていっても
向こうから叩きのめしに来るだろうな……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Geh! You're right... There's no way we can get them if they escape into the sea. Even the old man said that's how they ran away last time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
げっ！　
たしかに……
海に逃げられたら捕まえようがないぞ。
さっき言ってたけど
おっちゃんもそうやって逃げ切られてたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: If they set sail by boat, it's all over... By boat, huh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
舟で海に出られたらおしまいだな……
舟か……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's it! That boat! Hehehe... Haaahahahaaa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
それだ！　
舟だ！
……ふふふっ、
はーっはっはっはーっ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I have an idea! A good plan! I, the Great Villain Lady Novem, will wrap this up peacefully!
text_block_list.orig_text:
思いついたぞ！　
いい作戦！
この大悪党ノウェムさまが
平和に終わらせてやる！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: There's something I need you to do! Listen up, first...
text_block_list.orig_text:
オマエには
やってもらうことがある！
いいか、
まずは──

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After hashing out a plan together, {0} and Muimi hid nearby and waited for the poachers to appear.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それから二人で作戦会議を行った
{0}とムイミは、
身を潜めながら密漁者が現れるのを待った。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...Nobody's coming. Are they perhaps not in business today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……出てこないな。
もしかして
今日は来ないのか？

text_block_list.name: Poacher 1
text_block_list.text: ...We'll stop here for today. Let's sail the boat. Ready, and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……今日は
この辺りからにするか。
舟を下すぞ。
せーのっ……

text_block_list.name: Poacher 2
text_block_list.text: Whoops... Thankfully that old man isn't around today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よ
いっしょっと……
あのオヤジ、
今日はいませんね。

text_block_list.name: Poacher 3
text_block_list.text: He might come after us regardless. Stay vigilant. I wish he'd just give up already.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この後来るかも知れないだろ。
しっかり警戒してろ。
いっそ諦めてくれてりゃいいんだがな。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, so these are the poachers... As for the old man... he hasn't arrived yet. But if we're going to do it, now's the time. Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇー、
アイツらか……
おっちゃんは……
まだ来てないよな。
でもやるなら今しかない。
行くぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Don't move! You good-for-nothing poachers!
text_block_list.orig_text:
動くな！
オマエらが密漁してる悪いヤツだな！

text_block_list.name: Poacher 1
text_block_list.text: ...I was wondering who'd it be, but it's just two brats. Did that old man tell you to stop us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……誰かと思えばガキが二人か。
あのオヤジに言われて
俺たちを止めに来たか？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right! Come quietly! Or else you'll be in big trouble!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
その通りだ！　
大人しくしろ！
さもないと、
とんでもないことになるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Poacher 2
text_block_list.text: What should we do, bro?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうします、
兄貴？

text_block_list.name: Poacher 3
text_block_list.text: Should we buy 'em off?
text_block_list.orig_text: 金で揺さぶりかけますか？

text_block_list.name: Poacher 1
text_block_list.text: Hmph, they're just a bunch of brats. Let's grab 'em and sink them in sea! Get 'em!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふん、
所詮はただのガキどもだ。
手早くとっ捕まえて
沈めてやろうじゃねえか。
やっちまえ！

text_block_list.name: Poachers
text_block_list.text: OOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: おうっ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Here they come... Operation start! MANIFEST! SPIRESBANE BLADE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
来たな……
作戦開始だ！
現出せよ！　
天楼覇断剣！

text_block_list.name: Poacher 1
text_block_list.text: I don't know what kind of magic trick you're trying to pull, but know your place!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何の手品か知らねぇが
身の丈ってのを理解しな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: You're the ones who don't understand! Take this! DORYAAAAAAAAAH! SPIRESBANE SAND SLASH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かってないのはオマエらだ！
くらえっ！　
どおおおりゃあぁっ！　
天楼砂かけ斬ぁーん！

text_block_list.name: Poachers
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!?
text_block_list.orig_text: うおおおおっ！？

text_block_list.name: Poacher 1
text_block_list.text: Dammit! What a huge amount of sand... I can't see anything...! What the hell is going on...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそっ！　
なんて量の砂だ……
前が見えねえ……！
どうなってやがる……！？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: You're up! {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今だ
行け{0}っ！

text_block_list.name: Poacher 2
text_block_list.text: Ugh! Peh! Ptooey! Damn sand even got in my nostrils...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うえっ！　
ぺっ！　
ぺっぺっ！
鼻の穴にまで砂が……！

text_block_list.name: Poacher 3
text_block_list.text: My body's buried in the sand and I can't move...! B-Bro! This is bad!
text_block_list.orig_text:
体が砂に埋まって動けねぇ……！
あ、
兄貴っ！　
マズいですぅ！

text_block_list.name: Poacher 1
text_block_list.text: Just say what's wrong!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ！　
早く言え！

text_block_list.name: Poacher 3
text_block_list.text: The boat! One of those brats stole our boat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
舟が！　
ガキの一人が俺たちの舟を乗っ取りやがった！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Haaa ha ha ha! You fell for it! You can go ahead and set sail! Bon voyage!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーっはっはっはっはっ！
まんまと引っかかったな！　
船出の時間だ！　
行ってこい！

text_block_list.name: Poacher 1
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me... You planned to do this from the start...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか、
最初からこうするつもりで……！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: That's exactly it! Doesn't matter how badly you want to poach if you don't have a boat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのまさかだ！
いくら密漁したくても舟がなけりゃあどうしようもないよな！

text_block_list.name: Poacher 2
text_block_list.text: Damn it...! You're not gonna get away with this, you little shit!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちくしょう……！　
ただじゃ済まねぇぞこのクソガキィ！！

text_block_list.name: Poacher 3
text_block_list.text: Bro! Let's take care of that girl first!
text_block_list.orig_text:
兄貴！　
コイツだけでもやっちまいましょう！

text_block_list.name: Poacher 1
text_block_list.text: Stop telling me every single thing! Let's surround her quickly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いちいち言うな！　
おらとっとと囲むぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I was wondering how strong they were, but they don't seem that impressive... They're the kind of people who has more wits than brawn.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふーん……
どれくらい強いのかって思ってたのに、
大したことなさそうだな……
悪知恵だけは働くヤツらか。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Heh. I'll leave the rest to you, old man!
text_block_list.orig_text:
後はよろしくな！　
おっちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Yeah. You guys did great. Listen up, you bastards! Don't embarrass our guests!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
よくやってくれたなあんたたち。
いいかテメェら！　
客人に恥かかすんじゃねぇぞ！！

text_block_list.name: Fishermen
text_block_list.text: OOOOHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: おおおおおおおっ！！

text_block_list.name: Poacher 1
text_block_list.text: WHA...?! Damn, it's the villagers! Let's get out of here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ……！　
マズい村のヤツらだ！
逃げるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: Well now... Where'd ya think ye're going? Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう
兄ちゃん……
どこ行こうってんだ？　
ああ？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: No idea where ya're from, but ya surely did whatever'cha wanted in our sea, huh...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どこのもんか知らんが、
ワシらの海でよう好き勝手してくれたのう……？

text_block_list.name: Poacher 2
text_block_list.text: Ah... No...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
いえ……

text_block_list.name: Poacher 3
text_block_list.text: BRO! H-HELP ME!
text_block_list.orig_text:
兄貴ぃ！　
た、
助けてぇ～！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Looks like we can leave things here to the old man and his crew... Hey, {0}! You can return to shore!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここからはもう
おっちゃんたちにまかせてよさそうだな……
お～い{0}～！　
戻ってきていいぞ～！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: You did great, old man!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかったな
おっちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to you guys. Sorry for taking so long to prepare.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたたちのおかげだよ。
準備に時間がかかっちまって悪かった。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: It's fine, don't worry. By the way, who were those poachers in the end?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいってそれくらい。
ところでアイツら、
何者だったんだ？

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Well, apparently, they were villains who couldn't make a living thieving in Landosol so they tried their luck in the sea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それがな、
ランドソルでシノギができなくなって、
海で一稼ぎを企んでた悪党らしい。

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: But they were unlucky... it seems they didn't realize that the fishing ground they had targeted was controlled by our gang.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だが運が悪かったな……
たまたま目星をつけたのが
俺たちギャングの仕切る漁場だったとは知らなかったようだ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Gang...?
text_block_list.orig_text: ギャング……？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Well I'd be! So the lot of you are bad guys too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁんだよー！　
おっちゃんたちも悪いヤツだったのかぁ！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: I'm offended. We're more like insurance in case monsters, or guys like them, show up. ...Officially, anyway.
text_block_list.orig_text:
心外だな。
コイツらみたいなのや魔物が出た時の
保険みたいなもんさ。
……表向きはな。

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! The hell're we doing with these three?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁおい！　
コイツらぁ
どうするんだ？

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Since they wanted to go out to sea that badly, I thought we should indulge them... so I arranged for them to "work off their debt" on Oma's deep-sea routes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなに海に出たいなら好きなだけ行かせてやろうと思ってな、
仲間に連絡して、
オーマの遠洋での『借金返済』を手配しておいた。

text_block_list.name: Poacher 1
text_block_list.text: T-That's...!? NO!!! ANYTHING BUT THAT!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それは……！？　
嫌だ！！　
それだけは嫌だぁ～！！！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Actually, we need to pay compensation to our business partners all over the place. We had just incurred a debt that we couldn't possibly pay off... Well, I never imagined you guys would earn the money for us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は俺たち、
あちこちにいる取引先への賠償が必要でな。
とても払いきれねぇ額の借金をしたとこだったんだが……
いやぁ、
まさかあんたたちが代わりに稼いでくれるとはな。

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: How kind of ya... Ta pay all our debts, interests included. But ya won't be able to come back to land for three years! Be prepared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
優しいなぁ～、
俺らの借金を金利も込みで
『全部』肩代わりしてくれるなんてよぉ……
３年は陸に戻れねぇからな！　
覚悟しとけよ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: That's great! Now ye can "pay off" yer debts as much as ye want on the turbulent northern seas! Come on, hurry up and walk!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかったなぁ！　
これからは北の荒れ狂う海の上で
幾らでも『借金返済』できるぞ！　
ほれ、
さっさと歩け！

text_block_list.name: Poachers
text_block_list.text: NOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: いやだぁぁぁぁぁ～！！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Hehe, those guys... Bet they never imagined they'd end up pulling dirty tricks on people even worse than they were.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
アイツら……
悪いヤツ相手に悪いことをしてたなんて、
思ってもみなかっただろうな。

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Now... thank you, both of you. On behalf of everyone, allow me to offer my gratitude. We didn't even need to fight them though we were prepared to.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて……
ありがとう二人とも。
みんなを代表して、
改めて礼を言わせてくれ。
ヤツらと争わずに済んだよ。
戦う覚悟はしていたんだがな。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: If you're going to thank someone, thank {0}. At first, I thought just like you did and was planning to beat them all up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
礼なら{0}に。
最初はアタシも
おっちゃんと一緒で、
アイツらみんなぶっ飛ばすつもりだったよ。

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Guess we both have a tendency to do things the "bad way".
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだったのか？　
お互い悪いやり方が染みついちまってるな。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
まったくだ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi Man
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha ha!
text_block_list.orig_text: はっはっはっはっはっ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're back, {0}! Actually, you see... *chatter, chatter*... and that's more or less it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう、
戻ってきたな{0}！
実はな……
というわけだ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: It all depends on the situation. Fighting isn't always a bad thing, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっちゃんたちは
時と場合によるんだよ。
戦うのが全部悪いことってわけじゃないだろ？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: Ah, bro! Thank ya fer earlier! Yer efforts will get us back tah fishing tomorrow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
兄ちゃん！　
さっきはありがとうなあ！
おかげで明日からまた無事に漁ができるよ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: Ye gotta stay and have some of the fish we catch! I'll treat ye to the very best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
漁でとってくる魚、
食べてってくれよな！
一番上等なのを振舞うからよぉ！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Everyone's really grateful to you guys. We never would've thought of solving it that way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなあんたたちに感謝してるんだよ。
まさかあんなやり方があるなんて思わなくてな。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I was surprised too! Even good guys have their own way of beating the bad guys!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシも驚いたぞ！　
いいヤツなりのやり方でも、
悪いヤツらに勝てるんだな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, I guess I'll never be able to become a completely good person. I'd still get way more satisfaction out of beating those guys into the ground.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そう考えると
やっぱアタシは、
完全にいいヤツにはなれそうにもないな。
アイツらをぶっ倒した方が、
アタシはスカッとしちゃうし。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Compared to me, you really are a good guy! Still... it was nice getting to see what it feels like to be one of the good guys, even if only for a little while.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに比べて
オマエ、
やっぱいいヤツだな！
ちょっとだけいいヤツの気分が味わえてよかったぞ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Having resolved the situation without anyone getting hurt, Muimi found herself filled with a strange sense of fulfillment unlike anything she had ever experienced before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰も傷つかずに事態を解決に導けたことで、
ムイミは日頃感じたことのない
奇妙な充実感に包まれるのだった。
